Schema.Comment: The schema_version table stores the current version of the database schema. Implementations are expected to query this table on connecting to the database in order to ensure that the calling code is compatible with the tables in the database.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE schema_version ( version_lock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version_application_id TEXT NOT NULL, version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT schema_version_primary PRIMARY KEY (version_lock),
CONSTRAINT schema_version_check_lock_locked CHECK (version_lock = 1) ) STRICT

Schema.Comment: The inventory_blobs table stores references to typed blobs of data.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE inventory_blobs ( blob_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, blob_size INTEGER NOT NULL, blob_hash_algorithm TEXT NOT NULL, blob_hash_value TEXT NOT NULL, blob_type TEXT NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT blob_hash_unique UNIQUE (blob_hash_algorithm, blob_hash_value) )
Schema.Comment: The inventory_instruments table stores references to instruments.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE inventory_instruments ( instrument_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, instrument_group TEXT NOT NULL, instrument_name TEXT NOT NULL, instrument_version_major INTEGER NOT NULL, instrument_version_minor INTEGER NOT NULL, instrument_version_patch INTEGER NOT NULL, instrument_version_qualifier TEXT NOT NULL, instrument_meta_format TEXT NOT NULL, instrument_meta BLOB NOT NULL, instrument_title TEXT NOT NULL, instrument_description TEXT NOT NULL, instrument_blob INTEGER NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT instrument_blob_exists FOREIGN KEY (instrument_blob) REFERENCES inventory_blobs (blob_id),
CONSTRAINT instrument_unique UNIQUE ( instrument_group, instrument_name, instrument_version_major, instrument_version_minor, instrument_version_patch, instrument_version_qualifier ) )
Schema.Comment: The sample_maps table stores references to sample maps.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE inventory_sample_maps ( sample_map_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, sample_map_group TEXT NOT NULL, sample_map_name TEXT NOT NULL, sample_map_version_major INTEGER NOT NULL, sample_map_version_minor INTEGER NOT NULL, sample_map_version_patch INTEGER NOT NULL, sample_map_version_qualifier TEXT NOT NULL, sample_map_meta_format TEXT NOT NULL, sample_map_meta BLOB NOT NULL, sample_map_title TEXT NOT NULL, sample_map_description TEXT NOT NULL, sample_map_blob INTEGER NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT inventory_sample_map_blob_exists FOREIGN KEY (sample_map_blob) REFERENCES inventory_blobs (blob_id),
CONSTRAINT sample_map_unique UNIQUE ( sample_map_group, sample_map_name, sample_map_version_major, sample_map_version_minor, sample_map_version_patch, sample_map_version_qualifier ) )
